column1: # The app that opens each file type and URL scheme. scripts/default-apps
# keeps this Mac to the list: --check shows where it differs, --apply sets each
# type (macOS asks you to confirm each one), and --snapshot records a type
# that you gave to an app by hand. post-install runs --apply.
# One type on each line: the type, a tab, and the bundle identifier of the
# app. A type is a uniform type identifier, such as public.mp3, or
# scheme:NAME for a URL scheme. A line that starts with # is a comment, and
# an empty line is ignored. To find a file's type: mdls -name kMDItemContentType FILE
# Audio: Media Opener asks first (assets/media-opener). MP3, MPEG-4 audio
# (.m4a, and protected .m4p), WAV, AIFF, AIFC, MP2, FLAC and AAC.
# Video: Media Opener asks first. MPEG-4 (.mp4), .m4v, QuickTime (.mov), AVI,
